description:
Google Shopping Scraper (Cheap, No Browser)

Search Google Shopping by keyword and get one row per product: title, price, currency, old price, merchant, rating, review count, delivery, image and a shopping link. No browser, no API key. From $2.50 per 1,000 products.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Product delivered: $0.0025.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/google-shopping-scraper.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

concurrency.description: How many queries are fetched in parallel. Higher is faster but uses more proxy sessions at once. Default 5.
concurrency.title: Concurrent queries

gl.description: Two-letter country code for the Google country setting. It also decides the currency Google shows (us = USD, gb = GBP, de = EUR, my = MYR, ...). Examples: us, gb, de, my, sg, au, in.
gl.title: Country code (gl)

hl.description: Google interface language. Use a two-letter code like en, de or ms, or a regional code like en-GB.
hl.title: Language code (hl)

includeInlineThumbnails.description: Google embeds many product images directly in the page as base64 data (about 10 KB each) instead of linking them. Off (default): those rows get thumbnailUrl = null and your dataset stays small. On: thumbnailUrl holds the data: URI. Linked images (https://encrypted-tbn*.gstatic.com/...) are always kept.
includeInlineThumbnails.title: Include inline thumbnails

maxItems.description: Global cost ceiling: the run stops after this many product rows, across all queries. At $0.0025 per product, 100 rows cost $0.25. The default single query returns about 40 products, so a default run costs about $0.10 plus proxy usage.
maxItems.title: Max products per run (all queries)

maxProductsPerQuery.description: Upper bound on delivered product rows for each query. Google's first Shopping page is server-rendered with about 40 product cards and there is no working page-2 URL (verified November 2026), so in practice a query returns at most 40-50 rows; this cap just trims them.
maxProductsPerQuery.title: Max products per query

queries.description: One or more Google Shopping searches, e.g. `iphone 16` or `running shoes`. Each query returns Google's first Shopping results page (about 40 products). Add more queries to cover more products. Maximum 100 queries per run.
queries.title: Search queries

sortBy.description: How Google should order the results. Google's own sort control is discovered on each page and followed (one extra request per query); if the page shows no sort control the results stay in Google's default order.
sortBy.title: Sort order

name: google_shopping
